name: Utah caselaw — Caselaw Access Project — 1993–2019 (part-0002)
description: 7650 historical CAP case records, selected by CAP's jurisdiction label. Part of Utah caselaw — Caselaw Access Project; see the collection index for complete coverage. Preserves CAP's Utah jurisdiction assignment: 16,874 Supreme Court records, 6,029 Court of Appeals records under two source court labels, and one historical Salt Lake City Register and Receiver record. Coverage reflects the pinned historical archive, not every decision issued by those courts. OCR may contain errors; inclusion does not establish current legal authority.
